title: fix(plugin-auth): a minted principal session is never refreshed by a read, so it boots the console
body:
Fixes #23813

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

better-auth refreshed a session minted by `mintPrincipalSession` on **every** read. better-auth renews a session once `expiresAt - expiresIn + updateAge` has passed, and a 120-second session is past that from its first read. #23772's `holdPrincipalSessionExpiry` kept `expiresAt` where it was, but the refresh still ran. On each request it:

- rewrote the row's `updatedAt`,
- re-set the session cookie with a 7-day `Max-Age`,
- caused `bearer()` to answer `set-auth-token`.

The console's auth client (objectui `TokenStorage.subscribeRotation` in `AuthProvider`) treats `set-auth-token` as a token rotation and runs `loadSession` again. The new `user` object then re-runs `refreshOrganizations`, and the organization reads refresh the session again. The console never leaves "Opening your console…".

## Measured cause

Both of the card's hypotheses were tested on the same stack. The only variable toggled was the refresh skip; the minted `activeOrganizationId` stayed the same.

| Stack (the e2e below, real console at `.objectui-sha` `daeb77fc84`, Chromium 141) | admin, minted | member, minted | admin, normal sign-in |
|---|---|---|---|
| defect restored (ablation) | never booted: 553 `get-session` in 30 s, 1238 `set-auth-token` responses, 65 more `get-session` in the 3 s after | never booted: 651 / 1433 / 64 | boots |
| this PR | boots, 1 `get-session`, 0 `set-auth-token`, 0 after | boots, same | boots |

- **Hypothesis 1 (the read-time renewal write) is the cause.** Restoring only the refresh brings the loop back, and removing it ends the loop.
- **Hypothesis 2 (the active organization) is ruled out.** The same `activeOrganizationId` boots once the refresh is gone.

At the wire, a scratch probe on the real better-auth (`AuthManager.handleRequest`) before the fix showed every minted `get-session` on both lanes answering `set-auth-token` plus a session `Set-Cookie`, with `updated_at` advancing on every read and `expires_at` held. After the fix: no `set-auth-token`, no `Set-Cookie`, and `updated_at` unchanged.

## The fix (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth`)

- `principal-session-mint.ts`: adds `carriesPrincipalSession(ctx)`. It answers true when the request carries a minted session, either as the session cookie or as `Authorization: Bearer` (every spelling). It reads only the token brand and verifies nothing. That is deliberate: all it decides is "do not renew", which grants nothing. The module header gains section 3b.
- `auth-manager.ts`: the global `hooks.before` is the first hook every endpoint passes, before `bearer()`. When the request carries a minted session, it calls better-auth's own per-request switch `setShouldSkipSessionRefresh(true)`. better-auth's Next.js plugin sets the same switch for RSC reads. The switch is request-scoped, so it covers `get-session` and every endpoint that reads the session through better-auth's middleware (the organization reads included), on the cookie lane, the bearer lane and in-process.
- `holdPrincipalSessionExpiry` stays as the backstop for any renewal that does not ask the switch.

No `IAuthService` contract change, nothing in `packages/spec`. The built declaration closure of `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (`index.d.ts`, `index.d.mts`, `rate-limit-storage.d.ts`, `rate-limit-storage.d.mts`) is byte-identical at base `d7957199` and at head (sha256 compared after a build of each). Hence `Clause-②: no`.

### Alternatives (four axes, in short)

- **A signed dont-remember cookie.** This needs a second cookie in `PrincipalSession`, which is a `packages/spec` contract change. It would also hold only on the cookie lane: a bearer request carries no cookie. Rejected.
- **Returning `false` from `session.update.before`.** `updateSession` would then answer null, and `get-session` deletes the cookie and throws 401. Rejected.
- **Changing the console's rotation handling.** That works around the problem in the consumer. The producer (the server renewing a credential it promised never to extend) is where the defect lives. Rejected.

## Pins

- `plugin-auth/src/principal-session-mint.no-refresh.pin.test.ts`: a real better-auth through the real request seam, cookie and bearer lanes × `/get-session` and `/list-sessions` (which reads the session through `sessionMiddleware`, as the organization reads do). Each read must answer with no `set-auth-token`, no session `Set-Cookie`, and `updated_at` / `expires_at` unchanged. A control proves the same read does refresh an unbranded short session, so the pin cannot pass vacuously. Unit cases cover `carriesPrincipalSession`.
- `qa/dogfood/test/principal-session-console-boot.dogfood.test.ts`: the end-to-end pin. The showcase is booted in-process, with the built console composed into its plugins by the CLI's own `createConsoleStaticPlugin` (what `os serve` mounts). Each browser request goes to the real Hono app from a real Chromium. The minted cookie is set exactly as handed out. The test pins boot complete, no `get-session` in the settle window, and no `set-auth-token`, for an administrator and a member. A normal sign-in is the control. It needs the built console and a Chromium, and says `SKIPPED` without them. `playwright-core` `1.63.0` (already in the lockfile) becomes a devDependency of the private `@objectstack/dogfood`.
- #23772's pins (`principal-session-mint.test.ts`, `.cookie-lane.pin`, `.bearer-lane.pin`: TTL, no extension, revoke, refusals) are unchanged and green.

### Ablation

The defect was put back with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the `auth-manager.ts` line, gating the switch on an env var that is never set: injected 1, removed 0. The marker was confirmed in `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight` (exit 0). Results:
- No-refresh pin: 4 red, `read 1 reissued the minted session`. #23772's lane pins stayed green, as they should: the hold still holds.
- E2E: both minted cases red with the numbers in the table above; the control stayed green.

Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. The HEAD-blob hash matched, `git diff HEAD` was empty, and after a rebuild the marker was absent from `dist/` (exit 0 on the dist reading).

## Tests and gates (head `d4839df3ad`)

- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` → 150 files, 2942 passed, 10 skipped (pre-existing), exit 0. `typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/dogfood`: `test/principal-session-console-boot.dogfood.test.ts` → 3/3 passed with the built console (`daeb77fc84`) and Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`). `typecheck` exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 82 commands. Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe and stdin from `/dev/null`: 82 × exit 0. `--ran`: "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". One real red on the first pass was fixed: `check:test-source-alias` asked for `@objectstack/cli/console` to be aliased to source in dogfood's vitest config. Two first-pass exit-3 results were prerequisites, now met: the shallow clone was deepened (`git fetch --unshallow origin main`) for `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, and the 8 packages `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed were built.

## Acceptance notes

- The e2e pin skips wherever the console is not built or no Chromium exists, which likely includes `Dogfood Regression Gate` on CI. The wire half of the pin (`no-refresh.pin`) runs everywhere.
- `plugin-auth`'s `typecheck` excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so the new unit pin is type-checked by nothing local. Vitest transpiles it. `@objectstack/dogfood`'s typecheck does cover the e2e file.
- `pnpm install` also re-resolved `packages/apps/account`'s vitest peer to `esbuild 0.28.1`. That is pnpm's own output and was not hand-edited; #22269's dev recorded the same churn.
- #22269's PR #23811 binds the mint after this lands. `packages/services/service-print/**` was not touched.
